## ClusterServer interface

A server registered in a [ClusteredRedisQueue](/api/core/latest/core.clusteredredisqueue/)<!-- -->: its address, plus the [RedisQueue](/api/core/latest/core.redisqueue/) instance serving that host.

Returned by [ClusteredRedisQueue.addServer()](/api/core/latest/core.clusteredredisqueue.addserver/) so callers can address or inspect one specific host of the cluster.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface ClusterServer extends IMessageQueueConnection 
```
**Extends:** [IMessageQueueConnection](/api/core/latest/core.imessagequeueconnection/)
